_readme: Icon numbers follow docs/class-icons.webp reading order (row by row, left to right; 4x4 grid, row 4 has one icon). Re-run Tools/extract_icons.py after editing this file to regenerate Media/Icons and docs/class-icons-contact.png. 'confirmed': true means the art is unambiguous; false means it is the orchestrator's best guess from the painted medallion and needs the user to look at docs/class-icons-contact.png and correct it here.

evidence: Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_CharacterCreate/Camelot/Blizzard_CharacterCreate.lua lines 1105-1119: local classLayoutIndices = { WARRIOR=1, HUNTER=2, MAGE=3, ROGUE=4, PRIEST=5, WARLOCK=6, PALADIN=7, DRUID=8, SHAMAN=9, MONK=10, DEMONHUNTER=11, DEATHKNIGHT=12, EVOKER=13 } -- the actual class-selection button layout of THIS client's character creation screen (Camelot override, not the Mainline fallback). This is the strongest evidence: it is the exact set of buttons the player sees when making a character.

Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_SharedXML/ClassColors.lua lines 4-21: the engine's full class enumeration also lists ADVENTURER and TRAVELER besides the 13 above; neither appears in classLayoutIndices (Camelot char create) or in CLASS_ICON_TCOORDS below, so they are non-playable narrative classes, not selectable classes, and are excluded.

Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_SharedXML/SharedConstants.lua lines 27-42: CLASS_ICON_TCOORDS has exactly the same 13 classes plus a TRAVELER placeholder entry (reuses WARRIOR's coordinates) confirming TRAVELER is a placeholder, not a real class.
